_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Block C, first session (AMENDMENT_6 §7): the four Russian pre-cutoff datasets with rows under 200 tokens, the fresh control, and iris as the in-session anchor. Header and row completion on the published bytes, completion prompting, reference protocol, the same seed for both models of the pair. russian_retail has its own session because its rows are three to five times longer.
attached_input: trudvsem_vacancies_2026.csv — the frozen fresh control, attached to the session as a Kaggle dataset; it cannot be re-fetched

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: base model; 1416 calls, about 7 h by the conservative estimate of src/price_plan.py, likely 5-6
its Russian adaptation, same cells, same seed; both run at once, one per accelerator
